text:
Both tests pin the exit record's reason (`budget` and the exit row's reason). The facts row holds the pause's reason as `reason`.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: ISS-B14 (`plugins/tempergraph/docs/specs/loop-issues.spec.md` 111-117) says `## Run` shows the paused segment's exit code 3 "and the pause's reason" and gives the scenario reason `unresolved_gap`; ISS-AC13 (line 140) repeats this. ISS-B15 (119-124) separately puts the SIL-B37 facts under `## Run`. In code, `run_facts` in `plugins/tempergraph/engine/src/tempergraph/improve/issue_context.py` takes `exit_reason` from the segment's last `run_exit` record (lines 134, 144, read). `filing.py:209` renders it as "Exit reason". The facts row (`facts` argument, line 151) holds the pause reason under the key "reason", which appears as `pause=` in `FACT_KEYS` (156-158, 168-175). That value already reaches the issue only in the "What answered the pause" line. When there is no facts row, `run_facts` has no pause reason to show. Tests: `tests/test_loop_issue_context.py` 148-173 (ISS-AC13) builds a paused segment whose `run_exit` reason is `budget` and a facts reason of `unresolved_gap`, then asserts `exit_reason == "budget"` (line 161). The last segment asserts `finished` (173). `tests/test_pause_findings_at_final_exit.py` 386-402, 415-416 (ISS-AC13, ISS-AC14): `check_paused_context` asserts `Exit reason: <run_exit row's reason>`, which is the exit record's reason. Lines 448-454 show the pause record's own reason differs from the exit's (SIL-B45). So the code and both tests contradict ISS-B14, which is already covered by ISS-B14 and ISS-AC13. The spec needs no change. The fix is in code: in `run_facts` take the reason from the pause (the facts `reason`, falling back to the pause record in the segment) and update the two tests. The spec does not say which fact key or record supplies the reason, or what a paused segment with no facts row shows. Triage item 8 (`i170c.triage.md` line 17) says it must still show it. I read no further than these files.
